description: I'm an engineering student at IUT de Douala passionate about robotics, systems engineering, AI, and product design. Currently Studing  humanoid robot, I love solving complex hardware/software trade-offs. For Team OrbitCraft, we're creating an interactive multiplayer Space Mission Design Game. Join our 6-person team if you have skills in web/game dev, backend, physics/orbital simulation, UI/UX design, or space science storytelling!
summary:
We developed "Spacecraft," an interactive, collaborative web-based game focused on space mission design, created for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. The game allows 1 to 4 players to take on key roles within an agency Commander, Scientist, Engineer, or Communications Officer to design and launch space probes.
It addresses the challenge by accurately simulating NASA’s engineering constraints: teams must successfully balance mass, electrical power, budget, data throughput, and rocket thrust against their chosen destination (the Moon, Mars, or asteroids).
This project is significant because it democratizes learning about space science and engineering in a fun, accessible way. By transforming complex concepts such as mission design and CubeSat management into an interactive experience, it sparks scientific curiosity, fosters collaboration, and inspires the next generation of explorers.
details: Developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge, "Spacecraft" is an interactive, collaborative web-based game for 1 to 4 players. Participants take on key technical roles Commander, Scientist, Engineer, and Communications Officer to design, configure, and launch space probes toward various celestial bodies, such as the Moon or Mars. Built using HTML5, CSS3, modern JavaScript, and the Web Audio API, the game rigorously simulates the real-world constraints of aerospace engineering. Every decision impacts the rocket’s mass, energy capacity, data transmission rate, and budget. The game features an 8-level progressive campaign, mini-games, and random events. By transforming complex scientific concepts into an engaging and accessible experience, the project aims to spark curiosity in STEM fields and foster a spirit of teamwork among the next generation of explorers.
